The '''Betha system''' was a system located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="eao" /> The system contained the planet [[Betha II]].
